definition.coordinate_formula: For a native degree-eight basis monomial with one index from each pair and k y-indices: image is (-1)^(k/2)R8/128 for even k, (-1)^((k-1)/2)I8/128 for odd k. Other monomials map to zero.

transfer.filtered_reverse: T=D P8, H^8(A,Q)->W6; the corresponding rational algebraic cycle map sends CH^4(A)_Q to CH^3(X)_Q
transfer.opposite_Hodge_plane: R6*r+I6*s and I6*r-R6*s are killed by P8, but reverse to R6 and I6. They are Hodge tensors, not supplied algebraic cycles.

positive_test: An actual algebraic beta on A with T(cl(beta)) nonzero yields the original alpha by the existing 2x2 inverse. Nonzero arbitrary D(cl(beta)) can be only a divisor cube. Testing finitely many beta does not prove all-cycle vanishing.

Audit the auxiliary opposite Hodge sector when comparing filters; neither projector preservation nor the failed bounded divisor controls decides algebraicity.
